claims.claim: Researchers manually mapped 1943 subglacial valleys beneath the Greenland Ice Sheet using Ice Flow Perturbation Analysis.
claims.source_title: Uncovering the Valleys Hidden Below Greenland’s Ice
claims.supporting_quote: Using the technique, researchers manually mapped 1,943 subglacial valleys beneath the Greenland Ice Sheet, about a third of which are newly identified.

claims.claim: A paper in Nature Communications Physics led by Caley M. Harris resolved strontium abundance questions in an ancient star through laboratory testing.
claims.source_title: Astronomers Couldn't Explain This Ancient Star's Chemistry. A Lab Experiment Just Did.
claims.supporting_quote: A new paper published in Nature Communications Physics from a large group of researchers led by Caley M. Harris, a graduate student at Michigan State University, thinks they have found an answer for why that particular elemental level was skewed - and doing so required some very elaborate laboratory testing.
